english.title: Make radioactive device with intent to use in commission / preparation of terrorism - Terrorism Act 2006
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) made a radioactive device intending to use it in the course of or in connection with the commission or preparation of an act of terrorism or for the purposes of terrorism, or to make it available to be so used
english.legislation: Contrary to section 9(1)(a) and (3) of the Terrorism Act 2006.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
made radioactive device
intending to use it in the course of/in connection with the commission/preparation of an act of terrorism OR

english.notes:
(i) Section 9(2) of the Terrorism Act 2006 provides that it is irrelevant whether the act of terrorism to which an intention relates is a particular act of terrorism, an act of terrorism of particular description or an act of terrorism generally.
(ii) Section 9(3) of the Act provides the definition of radioactive device and radioactive material.
(iii) Also consider the following offence wordings: Possess radioactive device/material (H8465); Use radioactive device/material for purposes of terrorism (H8461); Use/damage a nuclear facility for purposes of terrorism (H8463); Make demand relating to radioactive device/material/nuclear facility (H8462); Make threat to use radioactive material/device/nuclear facility (H8464).
(iv) This offence applies to acts done outside the United Kingdom regardless of the nationality of the offender, see section 17.
(v) For the liability of company directors etc. see section 18.
(vi) Proceedings for this offence require the consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions, section 19.
(vii) See also Home Office Circular 8/2006, including explanations about this section.

other.powersofarrest:
For terrorist offences primarily consider: Arrest without warrant - terrorism
Also applicable: Arrest without warrant
other.penalty:
Imprisonment for life.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None This offence is also specified as a serious terrorism offence (Part 1 of Schedule 17A to the Sentencing Act 2020) and subject to serious terrorism sentences of imprisonment or extended sentences; see note (v) in section 306 for details.
